title: Expose cross-origin isolated capability and time origin to worklets
body: In "set up a worklet environment settings object", define both "The cross-origin isolated capability" and "The time origin" to return the corresponding values from `outsideSettings`. This is to support https://github.com/w3c/hr-time/pull/169 which seeks to expose `performance.now()` on `AudioWorkletGlobalScope` in the Web Audio API, which in turn seeks to support https://github.com/WebAudio/web-audio-api/issues/2413. Please see discussion there for further context. The state of the specification at time of writing this patch is as follows: - "The cross-origin isolated capability" was left as `TODO` when worklets were migrated into HTML (#6056). - "The time origin" asserted that it is never called (#7339). Delegating to `outsideSettings`'s cross-origin isolated capability and time origin allows `AudioWorkletGlobalScope` `performance.now()` to have the same coarsening behavior as in other contexts. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * [Chromium](https://github.com/w3c/hr-time/pull/169#issue-2836347817) * [Gecko](https://github.com/w3c/hr-time/pull/169#issuecomment-3835262120) - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * The [WebAudio IDLHarness test](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/webaudio/idlharness.https.window.js) will test for exposure of the API. Additional Web Platform Tests to be added as part of the linked hr-time and web-audio-api spec changes. - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://crbug.com/392542574 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2001624 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=326586 * Deno (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, module resolution, web workers, and web storage): N/A * Node.js (only for timers, structured clone, base64 utils, channel messaging, and module resolution): N/A - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A (developer-exposed API is part of https://github.com/w3c/hr-time/pull/169) - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
